paragraphs.text:
The ape-men put you all away for the night under a guarded 
overhang. Both Norman and Sylvia are badly injured. You do 
what you can for them—and for yourself.

You may make a First Aid roll. If you succeed, you regain 1D3 hit 
points, and so do your companions. Then, go to 389.
